# Usman Ramzan

Muhammad Usman Ramzan is a Lahore-based CTO and technical advisor. He makes cloud infrastructure boring in the good way: reliable, cost-honest, and quiet.

## Roles
- CTO at Eprecisio Technologies (Sep 2025–present): technology strategy for an enterprise multi-cloud Kubernetes platform across twelve cloud providers.
- Fractional CTO to four companies (healthcare SOC 2, travel AI assistant, manufacturing GDPR, media AWS/EKS).

## Background
- Seven years in cloud infrastructure: Emumba (2019–2022), Unifonic (2022–2025), Eprecisio (2025–present).
- At Unifonic: ~300 Kubernetes nodes, 10B+ messages/year, ~40 apps AWS EKS → OCI OKE with zero customer-facing downtime, $15–20K/mo savings.
- BS Computer Science, FAST-NUCES (2019). CKAD certified.
